notes_for_editor: Only the Forest Fire Lookout Association list and OpenStreetMap name this tower; neither gives a build date, builder, height, staffing or access. Two WebSearch rounds found no page that mentions a Swayne tower. The name may be local or a variant spelling; the name matches in both the list and OpenStreetMap. Other Sawyer County towers (West Fork, Connors Lake, Clam Lake, Pipestone) appeared in search snippets and in the Wisconsin Historical Society index pages but were not read as records, so they are not used here. A Forest Service PDF about Chequamegon-Nicolet 1930s towers was offered in a search result but returned 404 on fetch. The 2015 AP report does not name Swayne, so its status under the statewide decision is unknown. Budget: 2 WebSearch, about 6 page reads.
